attributes.axis_log: No source edit made; diagnosis only, so nothing to revert. fndiff --count 61/59 real 66; --ops target-only +2 addi, ours-only none. Aligned fnasm --diff at 0x0:0x20 shows the target emitting `addi r5,r3,0` at 0x4 and `addi r6,r4,0` at 0x10 -- MWCC's addi-form register COPIES of the two incoming parameters into scratch registers before the prologue -- then `addi r31,r5,0` from the copy; our build omits both copies and uses the ABI-arrival registers directly (`cmpwi r3,3`, `addi r31,r3,0`). The second cluster at 0x94:0xb4 is a pure schedule difference of the same count: the target materializes the lbl_8011AF48 ADDR16_LO at 0xa4 (after `li r4,0`) into r3, ours at 0x98 into r5.

attributes.mechanism: NAMED: the target home-copies both incoming parameters (r3->r5, r4->r6) into scratch registers in the pre-prologue region and thereafter reads the copies, while our build consumes the parameters in their ABI-arrival registers. These are two instructions the target contains that our build does not emit at all -- the count-asymmetric target-only copy class. The remaining local difference is an ADDR16_LO materialization scheduled two slots later in the target, at equal count.
